batches.note: The near shore: a turf bank one course above the sea, ringed by a sand beach flush with it, oaks and grass.
The far shore: a turf bank one course above the sea, ringed by a sand beach flush with it, oaks and grass.

The near boathouse: a stone footing on the sea floor, timber walls and a gable roof, a spruce jetty round a slip, the near ferry built of dark oak moored stern-to the jetty, a barred water-gate onto the strait, windows and hanging lanterns.

The far boathouse: a stone footing on the sea floor, timber walls and a gable roof, a spruce jetty round a slip, the far ferry built of dark oak moored stern-to the jetty, a barred water-gate onto the strait, windows and hanging lanterns.
